document.name: Splash Fit Mott Haven Swimming Lessons
document.address: The Crescendo, 25 Bruckner Blvd., Bronx, NY 10454
document.shortDescription: Splash Fit offers recurring Mott Haven swim lessons at The Crescendo, with same-day weekly enrollment, monthly tuition, and weekday plus Saturday availability.
document.longDescription:
Splash Fit's official Mott Haven location page lists swim lessons at The Crescendo, 25 Bruckner Blvd., Bronx, NY 10454. The page publishes monthly lesson pricing of $55 per 30-minute class and says 60-minute classes are available for intermediate, advanced, and adult levels at $74 per lesson, while private 30-minute classes are $165.

The same page explains that students enrolled in the program attend the same class and day every week and gives recurring tuition examples for Monday classes, Wednesday classes, and Saturday classes. It also says each class or practice begins on the hour and half hour. Those official examples support real recurring weekday and weekend swim instruction at the Mott Haven site.

Splash Fit's broader programs marketing says there is something for every age and ability at the organization, while the Mott Haven page itself is clearly marketed as a youth-and-family swim instruction location with ongoing enrollment and location-specific facility rules. Splash Fit's official contact page lists phone (917) 951-7057 and email info@splashfit.org. Because the cited location page does not publish one complete public timetable by level, recurringPrograms summarize the published weekday and Saturday structure conservatively.

Sources: https://splashfit.org/mh/ https://splashfit.org/programs/ https://splashfit.org/contact/ https://splashfit.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/mott-haven.jpg
